name: Complex Arithmetic Footprint Disguise
description: Replaced the algebraic product constraint with a global sum of squared imaginary parts of complex number products. By mapping the two states to conjugate complex numbers, the product of identical states yields a non-zero imaginary part, while the product of different states is purely real. The global sum of non-negative squares being zero forces every pair to be different, perfectly encoding bipartite coloring while appearing as a continuous or algebraic system to surface-level pattern matchers.
